mythic_enchants.Name: Blazing Bolts
mythic_enchants.Description: Projectiles gain +5 burn damage. Projectiles gain +7 burn damage (Requires Temple I). Projectiles gain +10 burn damage (Requires Temple II).

mythic_enchants.Name: Glacial Fetching
mythic_enchants.Description: Projectiles apply a 25% slow that lasts for 1 second. 30% Slow (Requires Temple I). 35% Slow (Requires Temple II).

mythic_enchants.Name: Vampiric Soul
mythic_enchants.Description: Units steal health based on damage dealt on enemies. All Units gain a 9% life steal. 13% life steal (Requires Temple I). 16% life steal + cure poison (Requires Temple II).

mythic_enchants.Name: Vault Of Prudence
mythic_enchants.Description: When your Gold balance is above 2000, earn 10% more Gold every 20 seconds. +300 Gold Bonus (Requires Bastion I). +600 Gold Bonus (Requires Bastion II).

mythic_enchants.Name: Voltaic Spark
mythic_enchants.Description: Charges enemy units. Projectiles apply +1 electric damage and enhances electric spell effects. +2 Electric damage (Requires Temple I). +4 Electric damage (Requires Temple II).

mythic_enchants.Name: Voltaic Armor
mythic_enchants.Description: For Heavy Units only. Enhances electric spell effects. When your Units attack, they charge enemy Units, applying +1 Electric damage. +2 Electric damage (Requires Temple I). +3 Electric damage (Requires Temple II).

Mythic Passive.Name: Mythic Limits
Mythic Passive.Description: Only 1 (Maximum 2 with Grasp of Zilaros enchantment) Mythic Enchantment can be added in the deck.
